title: Close Your Eyes and You See It All

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. was feeling unwell when I found her in town. Since she insisted
it wasn't serious, I decided to walk her back to her place for now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sorry about this. Making you walk me all the way home.
Phew... you really saved me...
choice_data_list: Maybe I should take you to a clinic after all?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm good.
I know this feeling—it's the kind that goes away after some sleep... *cough*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was still a bit worried, but lingering too long wouldn't be right either.
Just as I turned to leave—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I live alone, see. And right now, there's nothing in the apartment...
Sorry to ask, but... could you pick up some water for me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a closer look, not only was there no water, there wasn't a single bite
of food. I ended up buying groceries, cooking a meal... and before I knew it, I was fully nursing her back to health.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... this udon hits the spot...!
...Thanks a bunch, even making me a meal... You're a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I set out the prepared side dishes, medicine, and energy drinks on the table.
With all this, she shouldn't have any trouble even if she stays in bed for a few days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Just then, I felt Mr. C.B.'s eyes on me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, you know.
For turning down your scouts so many times.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're clearly a talented, kind Trainer. Anyone can see that just by watching you.
It's not your fault at all. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ......Back then, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—A long time ago, I joined a prestigious racing club. And I had
all kinds of famous Trainers working with me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Your strength truly shines when you run as a front-runner."
"Let's teach you all kinds of running styles so you can handle any situation."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Do that, and winning GIs, taking home URA awards—no, even becoming
a Triple Crown winner won't just be a dream." They told me things like that over and over. But—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't bring myself to care about winning GIs, or becoming a Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I get that to a Trainer, that's what matters most.
It's a huge achievement, a once-in-a-lifetime badge of pride.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, no matter what... Which race you win to get what honor,
how many times you have to win something to prove how amazing you are...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I couldn't care less about any of it.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Why can't you just listen to what you're told?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I clashed with the Trainers.
And ended up leaving.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Even now, I don't really get it.
Running for the future of Umamusume, like Rudolf does...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to see someone smile, wanting to bring excitement to the crowd... I get that
those are wonderful things, logically speaking.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But to me, that track isn't meant for any of that.
It exists purely for running—nothing more, nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...And that alone is pure, supreme bliss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She lives purely to run.
Her fundamental values are entirely detached from the rest of the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That said, there's no inherent requirement for Trainer and Umamusume to share the exact same dream.
Plenty of girls sign contracts with Trainers just to make their debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as both sides are willing to make a reasonable compromise,
it should be an easy problem to solve, but—
choice_data_list: (The fact that she can't compromise is why she's troubled.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to move forward without being fully convinced, utterly incapable of lying to herself.
Despite her carefree, breezy aura, she possessed an unyielding awkwardness at her core.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I replayed Mr. C.B.'s words in my head and pondered them...
an idea suddenly struck me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can't chase the GI victories or Triple Crown glory that a Trainer typically seeks.
In that case, if the Trainer could align with her values instead—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What if I could learn to love racing purely for the sake of racing,
just as passionately as she does?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You want to know what the scenery looks like from my eyes during a race?
choice_data_list: I want to understand what makes it so captivating to you.
I want to understand what makes it so captivating to you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, why?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I briefly explained my reasoning—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
......
You want to see things my way? You, Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...Did you not like the sound of that?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, no. Just surprised, is all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still... I like it. Yeah, not bad. Not bad at all.
Let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright then... close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Picture this: you're standing inside that narrow starting gate,
and right beyond it stretches the lush, vibrant green turf.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Lined up next to you are nearly ten hand-picked Umamusume. Rudolf, Ace...
every single one of them ready to give you an unforgettable race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The fanfare echoes, and the gates burst open.
You break out from that cramped, dark box and surge into the open green!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The turf feels soft beneath your feet today. Crisp, cool air cuts straight through you.
The girls next to you jockey for position, rushing forward one after another, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're not in the mood for that.
Let's see... you drop all the way to the back and take in the whole race from the rear.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Before long, you hit the third corner—here comes the slope!
You accelerate right along with your racing pulse, climbing up, plunging down—into the final corner!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around you kicks into high gear. Don't lose the heat; lock your eyes on the front runner!
Dig into the turf with everything your legs have got, short breaths, in and out—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And you just run!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Faster than the wind, faster than light, casting everything off as you surge ahead and ahead!
No one can stop you now, no one can hold you down...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—When I opened my eyes,
she was leaning in, looking right at me with flushed exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, talking about it kind of makes me want to go for a run myself.
So... well? How was it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could understand what kind of scene she was seeing.
Just imagining it made my own heart beat faster. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...? Well?
choice_data_list: (I feel completely outmatched by the raw passion in her voice...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her tone was gentle, fervent, and brimming with sheer love.
Whatever I was picturing surely paled in comparison to what she truly experienced.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had hoped to love racing just as much as she did, but...
perhaps it was presumptuous of me to think I could.
choice_data_list: ...I couldn't truly understand it after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, oh, is that so? ...Yeah, I guess that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You know, if you'd just lied and said you got it, I might've agreed to sign with you!
You're really, how do I put it—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Honest to a fault. ...Hehe.
